'''Erythrea''' is a continent in the middle-west region of the Avant world. It is an important geographic theater for [[People's Federation of Xanaqu|Xanaqu]] and several other states tied to twentieth-century political and ideological history.

== Geography ==

The continent is defined by major mountain systems, large desert regions, forests, wetlands, and river basins. Old source material describes a central mountain spine running through several states and a northern range associated with [[Democratic Republic of Suzuharu|Suzuharu]] and Hwanboguri.

Southern Erythrea includes Xanaqu's temperate forests, wetlands, coastal regions, and agricultural areas. The source also associates the [[Dongju River]] with Suzuharu's agricultural and trade geography. These geographic conditions shaped Xanaqu's state-building after 1936 by giving the new people's federation a defensible southern base and a varied resource foundation.

== Political Role ==

Erythrea is a useful map anchor for the Xanaqu formation chain: the fall of the [[Bu Dynasty]], the rise of [[Xun Tao]], the [[Taoist Party]], and the [[Xanaq Civil War]].

The continent still needs later cleaned pages for Khopda, Shangri-La, Hwanboguri, and other states named in the old source. [[Socialist Republic of Aurendale|Aurendale]] and [[Democratic Republic of Suzuharu|Suzuharu]] now have local bridge drafts, but their exact map placement and full state histories remain open.
